FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE

THE order under Section 3. that has to be read with Section 64.(1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), as Act, No. 13 of 1966, as amended by Acts, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009 that have to be read with Section 51 of the 19th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Re-public of Sri Lanka.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3. of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amended by Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, that have to be read with Section 51 of the 19th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President do by this order declare the Mandathivu Mangrove Forest of 462.209 hectares bounded by the limit set forth in the schedule hereto as Mandathivu Mangrove Reserved Forest from 12th day of October, 2019.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA, President.
Polonnaruwa, 12th day of October, 2019.
